name: Documentation Publishing
purpose: Build, version, and publish unified documentation sites from canonical Markdown sources with single-source builds, public/internal view separation, link validation, versioned releases, and redirect management.
inputs: Canonical Markdown sources root and pinned site generator version
Public vs internal classification and hosting base URL
Versioning policy with current stable version and maintenance window
outputs: Published or preview-deployable documentation site built from canonical sources
Version snapshot plus redirect table for the release
Build, link-check, sitemap, and smoke-test evidence
stop_conditions: Site builds cleanly, links resolve, sitemap matches public routes, and smoke tests pass
Version snapshot and redirects recorded for the release
